source_documents.title: Three polymorphs of one luminogen: How the molecular packing affects the RTP and AIE properties？

reference_evidence_units.quote: CzS-CN gave a very weak emission at about 529 nm in THF solution with a PL efficiency as low as 2.1%
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF solution; main text reporting SI S3.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Solution yield is 2.1% near 529 nm; emission increases at water fraction greater than 90%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI spectrum not inspected; source calls restriction 'intermolecular' in one sentence but identifies motion of molecular groups.

reference_evidence_units.quote: mainly caused by the motions of phenthiazine, cyan groups and phenyl ring
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of weak solution emission and aggregation enhancement.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors assign weak solution emission to motion of phenothiazine, cyano and phenyl units.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Motion-level source assignment, not direct measurement of specific torsional modes.

reference_evidence_units.quote: RTP lifetimes for the three polymorphs could change from 266 ms to 41 ms, then to 32 ms
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN crystals A, B and C
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Ambient crystalline forms; Figures 1 and 2 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Prose reports A/B/C RTP lifetimes 266/41/32 ms and total PL yields 22.6/17.8/6.9%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Both Figure 1 and Figure 2B show 226 ms for A, not prose 266 ms. Preserve conflict; total PL yield is not a phosphorescence-only yield.

reference_evidence_units.quote: RTP lifetimes shortening from 43 ms for the as-prepared powder to 11 ms in the ground state
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN powder
reference_evidence_units.statement: Grinding changes emission from 430 to 497 nm and shortens RTP lifetime from 43 to 11 ms.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: As-prepared powder resembles B by PXRD, not the long-lived A polymorph; fumed lifetime is 14 ms in Figure 2D.

reference_evidence_units.quote: For crystal (A), there were three major and one minor ISC channels
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN crystal-derived conformers
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors count more candidate ISC channels in A and B than C to explain RTP differences.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are energy/orbital-based proposed channels, not measured ISC rates.

reference_evidence_units.quote: crystal (C) should give the more efficient emission than others. But actually it was not
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN crystal conformers
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Calculated S0-S1 oscillator strengths compared with experiment.
reference_evidence_units.statement: C has f=0.21 versus 0.12-0.13 in A/B, yet lower measured yield, indicating monomer geometry alone is insufficient.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Negative result prevents reducing the whole behavior to isolated-molecule oscillator strength.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The strong intermolecular interactions would restrict the intermolecular motions effectively and lead to the reduced non-radiative transition
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN crystal A
reference_evidence_units.statement: Strong pi contacts and hydrogen bonds are proposed to suppress nonradiative decay and prolong RTP.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The quoted wording says intermolecular; no atomistic dynamics or oxygen-permeability control shown.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the formed H-type packing mode in coupled II
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN crystal C versus A/B
reference_evidence_units.statement: H-type packing of C is assigned to low efficiency; A/B have crossed X-type pairs.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Packing assignment is not a general H-aggregate description for all target forms.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the lowest excited state corresponded to the destructive combination of the transition dipole moment for the individual molecule, which was optically forbidden
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN crystal C coupled pair
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Coupled-unit transition-dipole analysis, main text reporting SI S14-S15.
reference_evidence_units.statement: C's parallel pair is assigned a dark lowest state; A/B crossed pairs have reduced splitting and finite lowest-state transition dipoles.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI diagrams not inspected; no higher-state emission is asserted.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve explicit assignment of solution loss to molecular-group motions and aggregate restriction, without treating all packing effects as internal rotation.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Different packing environments control nonradiative loss and emission; polymorphs cannot be pooled as equivalent.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: H-type versus X-type coupled-unit excited states underpin the polymorph fluorescence interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source explicitly distinguishes isolated-conformer oscillator strengths from packing-induced dark/allowed coupled states.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: RTP and proposed ISC differences are central, with explicit lifetime-source discrepancy preserved.
